gloss: the following month; the next month

definitions.gloss: the following month; the next month
definitions.explanation: The month immediately after a referenced point in time. Used primarily in written or formal contexts to refer to the month that follows a previously mentioned event or date.

examples.japanese: {翌月|よくげつ}に{届|とど}いた。
{料金|りょうきん}は{翌月|よくげつ}{払|はら}いになります。
examples.english: The fee will be charged the following month.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}したのは{四月|しがつ}で、{翌月|よくげつ}にはもう{出張|しゅっちょう}に{行|い}かされた。
examples.english: I joined the company in April, and the very next month I was sent on a business trip.

notes:
Composed of {翌|よく} (next, following) + {月|げつ} (month). A formal time reference word used mainly in writing, news, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌月|よくげつ}{払|はら}い: payment the following month
- {翌月|よくげつ}{末|まつ}: the end of the following month
- {翌月|よくげつ}の{初|はじ}め: the beginning of the following month

RELATED TIME WORDS WITH {翌|よく}:
- {翌日|よくじつ}: the next day
- {翌年|よくねん}: the following year
- {翌週|よくしゅう}: the following week
- {翌朝|よくあさ}: the next morning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {来月|らいげつ}: next month — used relative to the present moment ("next month from now"), whereas {翌月|よくげつ} is relative to a referenced past event
- {前月|ぜんげつ}: the previous month — the opposite direction in time
